## A — Exam authority, Section Six Knowledge examination

This dossier supports first-time, never-licensed applicants preparing for the West Virginia Class E knowledge examination. The issuing authority is the West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles within the West Virginia Department of Transportation, and the source is the current revised edition of the West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook pinned in the run configuration. The registrar verified no official question count, passing score, test format or time limit for the knowledge examination, so this dossier asserts no value for any of them. The handbook's own examination chapter describes a question minimum and a passing line in its text; those lines travel only as cited knowledge facts in the knowledge-examination section of this run, never as verified exam facts. Practice scoring follows only the accepted LearningLoop product policy. Section Six covers the examiners' message about what the tests measure, the vision screening standard and its restriction and specialist-statement paths, the knowledge examination's question minimum, passing line, time limit and audio version, the DUI awareness course, the road test vehicle check, and the list of illegal vehicle equipment.

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so the Section Six Knowledge examination content changes at most with a new edition.
